audit_items.proof_trace: The fail-fast error handling pattern directly violates the invariant. If any of the 15 sub-processes (lines 69-119) returns an error, execution stops immediately and remaining processes are NOT executed, leaving state partially processed. This breaks the strict sequential execution requirement.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts P2P block/attestation that triggers an error in any middle sub-process (e.g., ProcessSlashings at line 84). Steps before the error execute and mutate state, but all subsequent steps are skipped, causing state inconsistency across the network.
